readings: Looking at how much each film rating gets rented (going from rentals through the inventory copy to the film), take the ratings that are above the average across ratings. Give me one row: the average figure for those ratings and how far above the overall average they are on average. No rounding.
queries:
WITH rentals_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals
  FROM rentals_by_rating
)
SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals,
       AVG(rental_count - average_rentals) AS average_above_overall
FROM rentals_by_rating
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE rental_count > average_rentals
